# external.tpa__oracle_categories__v1

## Purpose
Static reference dump of the **Oracle Data Cloud / BlueKai** third-party audience-category taxonomy — the
full category tree Oracle exposed to its DMP/DSP customers (MNTN/SteelHouse being one). Use it to **decode
an Oracle/BlueKai category id into a human-readable name, description, and hierarchy path**, and to see which
data provider (`vertical_name` / `partner_id`) supplies each segment. This is the naming dimension for the
legacy **Oracle (DS1)** data source: DS1 no longer delivers IPDSC volume (Sean Yang, 2026-05-29) but its
category ids still appear in old prospecting clauses and historical analysis, and this table is where their
meanings live. Also contains MNTN's own **SteelHouse Private DMP** self-classification segments (CRM uploads)
that were housed inside Oracle's DMP.

Federated GCS Parquet external table — a one-time snapshot (content last updated Feb 2024; GCS objects written
2025-09-18), not a refreshed feed.

## Grain & keys
- **Grain:** one row per Oracle/BlueKai category node. `data_source_category_id` is **unique** — 161,969 rows,
  161,969 distinct ids (verified 2026-07-19). No `data_source_id` column (unlike the dstillery sibling); every
  row is Oracle's own id space.
- **Key:** `data_source_category_id` (PK). `parent_id` self-references it to form the tree (root = id `0`,
  `name='ROOT'`, `parent_id IS NULL` — the single null-parent row).

## Column meanings (only the non-obvious ones)
- **`data_source_category_id`** — Oracle/BlueKai's **own** category id (0 … 2,224,588). This is NOT MNTN's
  `integrationprod.categories` / `ipdsc` `data_source_category_id` space — do not blind-join it to MNTN
  category tables (see Joins).
- **`parent_id`** — id of the parent node; `NULL` only for the root (`id=0`). 29,846 distinct parents; the
  tree is 6 levels deep in sampled branches (ROOT → tier → provider → category → subcategory → leaf).
- **`names`** — JSON string `{"names":["ROOT","Branded Data","Experian","Auto","Purchase Predictor","Luxury Car - Domestic"]}`
  = the **human-readable ancestor-name path** from root to this node. `names[1]` = top tier (e.g. "Branded
  Data"), `names[2]` = data provider (e.g. "Experian"). **This is the readable path — use it for name matching,
  not `path_from_root`.**
- **`path_from_root`** — JSON string `{"pathFromRoot":[0,24148,161455,330135,240010,240017]}` = the same path
  as a list of **ancestor category IDs** (unreadable). Mirrors the "struct/id" `path_from_root` form documented
  for premium providers in `tpa.categories` — regex on this yields nothing; parse `names` instead.
- **`vertical_name`** — provider/data-partner label, e.g. `"Branded Data - Experian"`, `"Branded Public - Acxiom"`,
  `"Private DMP - Steelhouse, Inc."` (23,506 rows — MNTN's own segments). 181 distinct. Roughly `names[1] " - " names[2]`.
- **`ownership`** — `thirdParty` (134,265, = every `public=true` row), `firstParty` (23,508, mostly the
  SteelHouse Private DMP self-classification uploads), `secondParty` (4,195), 1 NULL (root).
- **`category_type`** — `regular` (138,389) vs `selfClassification` (23,580, = customer-uploaded segments such
  as CRM lists).
- **`public`** — true iff third-party/marketplace-visible; exactly tracks `ownership='thirdParty'` (134,265).
- **`deprecated`** — true for **58,845 rows (~36%)**; a live snapshot still contains many retired segments —
  filter `deprecated=false` when you want the currently-usable taxonomy.
- **`is_leaf_node`** — true for 132,401 (targetable leaves); false = interior/navigation nodes.
- **`analytics`** — near-constant true (161,904 / 161,969). Low signal.
- **`links`** — JSON array of related-category links; empty `[]` for ~44%, populated for 91,577 rows.
- **`status`** — `active` for all but 1 row (the root, NULL). **`visibility_status`** — constant `notHidden`
  (all 161,969). **Both are effectively dead columns.**
- **DEAD / constant columns (do not use as filters):** `explicit_price_floor` (all false),
  `data_source_category_type_id` (all NULL), `visibility_status` (all `notHidden`), `mutually_exclusive_children`
  (true for only 51 rows).
- **`created_date` / `updated_date`** — DATE (not epoch). Content spans 2018-07-25 … 2024-02-20; this is a
  frozen snapshot, so these are the segment's real Oracle lifecycle dates, not load dates.

## Joins & relationships
- **Self-join (hierarchy):** `parent_id → data_source_category_id`. 1:N (a parent fans out to its children).
  Walk up via `path_from_root` ids or read the ready-made readable chain in `names`.
- **`partner_id` → `vertical_name`:** NOT 1:1. 105 distinct `partner_id`s; 35 of them span multiple
  `vertical_name`s (e.g. a provider appearing as both "Branded Data - X" and "Branded Public - X"). Treat
  `vertical_name` as the finer provider label; don't assume `partner_id` uniquely names a provider.
- **To MNTN's own tables — CAUTION, unverified:** the ids here are **Oracle/BlueKai native ids**, a different
  space from MNTN's `integrationprod.categories`, `external.ipdsc__v1`, and the DS19
  `tpa__mntn_matched_taxonomy__v2` (≥900000) id space. Legacy DS1 (Oracle) targeting clauses *may* reference
  these Oracle ids, making this the lookup for decoding them, but that join is **not empirically confirmed**
  (DS1 no longer delivers IPDSC, so there is no live IPDSC partner to check against). Do not present an
  id-join to MNTN category tables as verified.
- **Sibling taxonomy tables:** `external.tpa__dstillery_categories__v1`, `external.tpa__sharethis_categories__v1`
  (other 3P provider taxonomies), `external.tpa__mntn_matched_taxonomy__v2` (DS19 MM Core names). Same shape,
  different id spaces — never cross-join their ids.

## Gotchas
- **`path_from_root` is the unreadable ID-struct form here.** Do NOT `COALESCE(path_from_root, names, name)` for
  name matching — you'd get `{"pathFromRoot":[...]}`. Parse **`names`** (`{"names":[...]}`) for readable text
  (mirrors the `tpa.categories` DS35 premium-provider gotcha in `data_catalog.md`).
- **Static snapshot, not a feed.** Content frozen at Feb 2024; GCS objects written once (2025-09-18). No new
  Oracle segments arrive — do not expect recency.
- **~36% of rows are `deprecated=true`.** A raw scan over-counts the live taxonomy; add `deprecated=false`.
- **Oracle id space ≠ MNTN id space.** Biggest trap: assuming `data_source_category_id` joins to MNTN's
  `categories`/`ipdsc`. It does not (they are Oracle/BlueKai ids). Confirm before any cross-table id join.
- **Legacy relevance only.** DS1 Oracle is a dead delivery source; this table is a historical/decoding
  reference, not something the live bidding pipeline reads.

## Cost & partitioning notes
- **No partitioning, no clustering, no TTL.** Single static GCS prefix
  `gs://mntn-data-archive-prod/static/oracle_categories/*.parquet` (`static/`, not hive `dt=`), so there is
  **no partition column to prune** — every query scans the whole object set.
- **GCS backing:** ~**20.34 MiB** of Parquet total (≈63 files ~330 KB each; `gsutil du`, 2026-07-19). Small.
- **Dry-run reports 0 bytes** for this table (federated external Parquet — BQ cannot pre-estimate GCS scan
  size); `--dry_run` byte figures are meaningless here. Because the object is only ~20 MiB, `SELECT *` is
  cheap in absolute terms, but there is no pruning: **select only the columns you need** (`data_source_category_id`,
  `name`, `names`, `description`, `vertical_name`, `is_leaf_node`, `deprecated`) rather than `*`, since the
  wide `names`/`path_from_root`/`links`/`description` string columns dominate the bytes read.
- **One filter to always apply:** `deprecated = false` (drops ~36% retired nodes) — there is no partition
  filter to apply.

## Example queries
```sql
-- Decode a set of Oracle category ids to readable name + provider + path
SELECT data_source_category_id, name, vertical_name, ownership, deprecated,
       JSON_EXTRACT_STRING_ARRAY(names, '$.names') AS name_path
FROM `dw-main-bronze.external.tpa__oracle_categories__v1`
WHERE data_source_category_id IN (240017, 240033, 326877)
  AND deprecated = false;

-- Live targetable leaves for one provider
SELECT data_source_category_id, name, description
FROM `dw-main-bronze.external.tpa__oracle_categories__v1`
WHERE vertical_name = 'Branded Data - Experian'
  AND is_leaf_node AND NOT deprecated
ORDER BY name;
```
